title: Tests: send_message() wiremock suite
description:
**What:** Write independent test suite for send_message() using wiremock as oracle.

**Algorithm (test-first — write before looking at implementation):**
Oracle: all expected values derived from mock JSON payloads, not from running send_message as its own oracle.

Test 1 — success path:
- Mock POST /jmap/api responds: {methodResponses: [['Message/set', {accountId:'a-self', newState:'s-2', created:{'k-1':{id:'msg-001', senderId:'self', deliveryState:'pending'}}, notCreated:{}}, 's0']]}
- Call send_message(client, url, 'chat-abc', 'hello')
- Assert: Ok('msg-001') returned.

Test 2 — notCreated error:
- Mock responds: {methodResponses: [['Message/set', {accountId:'a-self', newState:'s-1', created:{}, notCreated:{'k-1':{type:'invalidArguments', description:'body too long'}}}, 's0']]}
- Call send_message(client, url, 'chat-abc', 'x')
- Assert: Err returned; error string contains 'invalidArguments' or 'body too long'.

Test 3 — JMAP method-level error:
- Mock responds: {methodResponses: [['error', {type:'serverFail'}, 's0']]}
- Call send_message(client, url, 'chat-abc', 'hi')
- Assert: Err returned; error string contains 'serverFail'.

Test 4 — empty body:
- No mock server needed (must short-circuit before HTTP).
- Call send_message(client, url, 'chat-abc', '')
- Assert: Err returned without making any HTTP call (verify by not mounting any mock and using http://127.0.0.1:1 as unreachable URL).

Test 5 — whitespace body:
- Same as Test 4 with body = '   '.
- Assert: Err returned.

Test 6 — network error:
- No mock; use http://127.0.0.1:1 as URL.
- Call send_message(client, url, 'chat-abc', 'hello')
- Assert: Err returned.

**Defensive rules:**
- Never use send_message return value as the expected value. 
- All expected values ('msg-001', error types) come from the mock JSON above.
- Tests must be fully offline — no real kithd.

**Agent team:** T writes tests independently from bead spec; I (the W1A implementer) is not consulted; V runs cargo test -p kith-tui.
